title: Modeled Bloom-filter false positives
method: Textbook approximation 100 × (1 − exp(−k*n/m))^k with m=10,000 bits and k=7; n=1,000 gives about 0.82%, n=2,000 about 13.78%. Assumes uniform hashing and absent query keys. Synthetic model, not measured library performance.
alt: Modeled Bloom-filter false positives. 1000 inserted items: 0.82 percent; 2000 inserted items: 13.78 percent. Illustrative inputs.
